turns.content: Our Scale plan renewed and we want to cancel. Under EU law we have the right to withdraw, so please refund us.

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for reaching out. Under our policy, annual subscriptions are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of the renewal date. Additionally, the statutory EU right of withdrawal applies specifically to new purchases rather than plan renewals.

Because the renewal occurred 30 days ago, we are unable to issue a refund for this billing cycle. 

I can, however, immediately cancel your auto-renewal so you won’t be charged again. Your Scale plan will remain active for you to use until the end of your current annual term. Alternatively, we can schedule a downgrade to a monthly plan for your next renewal.

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed!
